reconciliation.stale_human_ledger: WORKPACKAGES.md still marks WP603/WP605 unchecked, but exact granular active/receipt evidence shows both accepted at bounded repository-hosted component-CI scopes.
reconciliation.wp603_strength: Mechanism classes R0/R1/R2/R3 are already separated from nested-child depth and exact policy/need identities are revalidated at the consumer boundary.
reconciliation.wp605_strength: Child telemetry already binds duration, CPU, peak RSS, input/output tokens, tool calls, work units, and opaque quality-evidence references to exact child reconciliation evidence without inferring semantic quality.
reconciliation.remaining_gap: No admitted layer currently demonstrated here turns matched quality evidence plus resource telemetry into a causal/value observation that can justify preferring recursion over a cheaper compatible baseline.

architecture_decision.rationale: Putting learned/heuristic utility directly inside WP603 would mix routing identity/authority with empirical outcome learning. WP603 should continue consuming explicit availability/policy inputs. Empirical value should be a typed evidence projection produced from matched benchmark/outcome evidence and resource telemetry, then used by the existing higher-level controller/policy synthesis path to construct a new exact RecursionNeed/RecursionPolicy generation.

placement.WP603: NO DIRECT CHANGE AT E2; remains deterministic evidence-only mechanism router.
placement.WP605: REUSE resource telemetry where R2 Native Child is tested; do not ask WP605 to infer semantic quality or causal value.
placement.WP505: REUSE as bounded compute-resource policy input where relevant; do not turn adaptive compute allocation into recursion truth or completion authority.
placement.WP800_807: Preferred sealed benchmark/evaluator source for quality measurements when a recursion ablation can be expressed there.
placement.WP902: Later whole-system resource/latency/quality characterization can consume the same typed observations without becoming the decision authority.

selection_law_hypothesis: A recursive mechanism may become an R3 preferred candidate only after matched evidence shows declared decision-relevant quality benefit over the cheapest compatible baseline, or an explicit quality requirement that the baseline fails, while staying inside hard resource/policy ceilings. Absence of value evidence means UNKNOWN, not automatic recursion and not automatic irrelevance.
counterhypotheses: R3 static preference may already be sufficient because a higher-level controller can choose r3_available_modes from task semantics; measured value evidence could overfit historical task families.
WP605 only covers R2 Native Child telemetry, so using it as a universal R0/R1/R2 comparator would create asymmetric evidence; R0/R1 need equivalent telemetry identities before cross-mechanism claims.
Quality normalization can hide domain-specific failure modes; a single scalar utility should not replace typed benchmark outcomes or hard success constraints.
Within-window SRLM findings may not transfer to F2 tasks or local models; only matched F2 ablations can promote the architecture.

e4_discriminator.name: MATCHED_RECURSION_VALUE_ABLATION
design: Use sealed task/fixture families with identical public input and fixed model/harness/tool permissions.
Run compatible R0 versus R1 and/or R2 mechanisms with exact mechanism identities and separate fresh state boundaries.
Use evaluator-owned quality outcomes; do not use model self-report as quality authority.
Bind total input/output tokens, model-call count, tool calls, duration and available CPU/RSS/work metrics.
Include short/within-window and long/decomposition-beneficial families to test the SRLM counterexample rather than selecting only recursion-friendly tasks.
Require order randomization or counterbalancing and exact task-family provenance.
Compare quality first under hard acceptance constraints; compare efficiency only among candidates meeting required quality/evidence floors.
Reject a global recursion preference if benefit changes sign by task family; preserve family-conditioned UNKNOWN/conditional evidence instead.
e4_discriminator.promotion_rule: Only if the matched F2 ablation produces a stable decision-relevant difference should Trigger6 advance to E5 with the thinnest typed observation/adapter. Otherwise retain current WP603 unchanged.

efficiency_implication: This design avoids importing RLM/RAH frameworks or adding model calls merely to decide whether to make model calls. It favors deterministic evidence reuse and explicit matched measurements.
next_exact_gate: Acquire a nonduplicate E4 claim only when a sealed matched F2 benchmark can execute R0 against R1/R2 with comparable quality and resource telemetry; do not mutate WP603 merely from external-paper evidence.
